title: People who love structure
header_line: My analysis of one book on neuro-linguistic programming. Not a summary of the book. Not affiliated with or endorsed by the author or publisher.

lines.text: What kind of person feels safe with structure and targets?

I described a type of person: you like your routine, repeatable work, key performance indicators, short-term execution, hitting your targets, a clear structure that makes you feel safe, and giving rewards for performance.

groups.heading: When it fits and when it does not

lines.text: I said that a creative meeting about new ways to do things would not be practical in a military operation, so structure fits some places. I compared it with places where creativity is the point.
A student said that the book contradicts the idea that emotions are primal and arise on their own, because there is more room to influence them.

exercise.title: Five minutes
steps: Write the kind of person you are about structure.
Write who you work with who is the other.
Write one place where structure helps.
Write how you will speak to each kind.
